answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the whisper of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Every claim climbs the violet of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the terrace re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, converted to a slow vesting stream, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short.
